hook_text: Fifteen messy marks. One stem-and-leaf. Suddenly you can see everything.
clip_script: A stem-and-leaf display groups data and keeps every value at the same time. Split each mark into a stem, the tens digit, and a leaf, the units digit.
visual_style: Jumbled numbers fly onto a vertical stem line, splitting into tens and units; the 30s row grows longest and glows.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to organise any data set.
